# Types & Version Bumps

- `feat`: Minor (x.Y.z) - New feature
- `fix`: Patch (x.y.Z) - Bug fix
- `perf`: Patch (x.y.Z) - Performance improvement
- `docs`, `chore`, `style`, `refactor`, `test`: No bump (unless breaking)
- `BREAKING CHANGE:` (or `!` after type): Major (X.y.z)
